title: Infant Care Video Dataset for Classification of Interventions Using Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2608.23838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Healthcare documentation in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) presents significant challenges, with nurses spending approximately 25\% of their time on record-keeping, while up to 60\% of interventions remain undocumented. Motivated by the need to detect interventions from video automatically, we present the Infant Care Video Dataset (ICVD), a collection of 4,144 videos spanning 12 simulated intervention classes designed for developing automated documentation systems. Our manikin-based approach systematically varies conditions, such as camera angle and clinician skin tone, while ensuring privacy compliance. Using video transformer architectures (TimeSformer and MotionFormer), we establish strong baseline performance (93.97\% and 93.17\% top-1 accuracy) among the 12 infant care classes. translated_title: 婴儿护理视频数据集：基于Transformer的干预分类研究
translated_abstract: 新生儿重症监护室（NICU）中的医疗文档记录面临重大挑战，护士约25%的时间用于记录，而高达60%的干预措施未被记录。受自动从视频中检测干预措施的需求驱动，我们提出了婴儿护理视频数据集（ICVD），包含4，144个视频，覆盖12个模拟干预类别，旨在开发自动化文档系统。我们的基于人体模型的方法系统地变化条件，如摄像角度和临床医生肤色，同时确保隐私合规。使用视频Transformer架构（TimeSformer和MotionFormer），我们在12个婴儿护理类别中建立了强基线性能（top-1准确率分别为93.97%和93.17%）。我们的消融研究将时间模型与逐帧方法（准确率23.17%）进行比较，显示70.80%的性能差距，验证了时间建模的必要性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个婴儿护理视频数据集（ICVD），并利用视频Transformer模型实现了高准确率的干预分类，显著优于逐帧方法，为NICU自动化文档记录提供了有效支持。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Infant Care Video Dataset (ICVD) and achieves high-accuracy intervention classification using video Transformers, significantly outperforming framewise methods, supporting automated NICU documentation.
